name: Memory Enhancements
description: Four layered wins on top of upstream memory-core: O(1) anchor → chunk hippocampus index, task-conditioned retrieval scoring, structured contradiction-gate on writes, and compaction-aware message capture. Drop-in plugin — upstream memory-core stays exactly as shipped. Designed to be published on ClawHub.

indexDir.description: Where the pre-computed anchor → chunk concept index is stored.

minConceptLength.description: Minimum concept token length to be indexed (shorter tokens are noise).

importanceThreshold.description: Minimum importance score [0,1] for a concept to survive pruning.

taskWeight.description: How strongly current task context biases retrieval scores [0,1].

mode.description: warn: log contradictions but allow the write. block: refuse the write.

captureMode.description: dropped-only: snapshot only messages about to be lost. full-context: snapshot entire context window.
